name: Astrid Nielsen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. While studying hospitality management in Copenhagen, she took on a summer internship at a local racing event, providing meals for the pit crews. The fast-paced environment and the dedication of the teams captivated her. After graduating, she actively pursued opportunities within motorsport, eventually landing a role with Akkodis ASP Team. 

Astrid believes that a well-fed team is a successful team. She focuses on providing nutritious and delicious meals that cater to the specific dietary needs and preferences of the drivers and crew. Her meticulous planning and understanding of the logistical challenges of race weekends have quickly made her an indispensable part of the team. What sets Astrid apart is her dedication to sourcing local, sustainable ingredients whenever possible, adding a touch of Danish hygge to the high-octane world of racing.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail during race events.
physical.description: Astrid has a bright, friendly face with high cheekbones and a warm smile.

quirks: Insists on having a specific brand of licorice available at all times.
Always listens to classical music while prepping meals.
Carries a small notebook filled with handwritten recipes and dietary notes.
